newsitem.title: THAILAND: Amnuay calls for Thai finance company mergers.
newsitem.headline: Amnuay calls for Thai finance company mergers.

text.p: Thai finance companies should merge to boost their efficiency and stability in the face of a liberalising financial environment, Thai Finance Minister Amnuay Viravan told reporters on Saturday.
"To fight in a global, liberalised environment mergers (of finance companies) are essential and should take place," he said.
But Amnuay said amalgamation of Thai finance firms was best achieved on a voluntary basis.

"The government will not force these mergers on finance companies and they should take place on a voluntary basis to raise their efficiency," he told reporters at an Association of Finance Companies meeting in this resort town.
He defended government measures taken this week to shore up the troubled Thai finance sector. The sector has been hit by deteriorating asset quality amid a property slump and a slowing economy.
On Monday shares of all bank and finance stocks were suspended as the central bank moved to address a growing liquidity crisis and set stringent new loan provisioning standards.
"We have to take the pain in order to prevent death in the future ... If we need to perform surgery, we should do it," Amnuay said.
